findings.claim: README §4, ADR-0011:41 and ADR-0013:18 install Codex as a plugin (`codex plugin marketplace add --ref release`), but PRD E25 says Codex installs as a plain config.toml MCP entry, not a plugin, because a plugin spawns in the cache dir with no ${VAR}. Plugin install gives no project source, so #1210 comes back.
findings.evidence: PRD-v2.md:179 E25; PRD-v2.md:95-96 (spawn cwd = Codex CLI plain config.toml only; 'Codex plugin install' = no automatic source); tickets/spike-project-source.md:15 'Codex plugin install | none (cwd = plugin cache, no ${VAR}) | verified gap | openai/codex #37903'; tickets/map-I0.md:31 #1210 'Codex Windows project dir falls back to plugin cache'
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY v1 646ca060 2026-05-02 'fix(codex): default projectDir to cwd when env and input missing'; 98d239b7 2026-06-14 'fix(codex): resolve plugin-manager root for doctor and upgrade (#771)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: project dir = spawn cwd, never the plugin root. REGRESSION_RISK: plugin install => project key = plugin cache dir (#1210 re-break). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one install mode per agent (PRD E14).
findings.fix: Pick one Codex install mode in the docs. If plugin: show how the server gets the project dir (hook payload cwd, or MCP server `cwd`/env in the plugin manifest) and test it live. If plain config.toml: change README §4, ADR-0011 c) and ADR-0013 smoke, and say how update works without a marketplace.

findings.claim: The CI live matrix lists OPENAI_API_KEY as the Codex auth secret. Owner decision: no API keys for tests. ADR-0012 says Codex runs keyless with a ChatGPT login.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:360 '| Codex CLI | required | `codex exec --json ...` | OPENAI_API_KEY |'; ADR-0012:15 'it is logged in with ChatGPT. `codex exec` runs with no key, using a temp CODEX_HOME that contains only a symlink to auth.json'
findings.fix: Replace the secret column for Codex with the ADR-0012 temp CODEX_HOME + auth.json symlink method, or mark the CI row superseded by ADR-0012.

findings.claim: Generated matchers from adapters/table.ts carry no rule that Codex matchers must be literal names only. Codex's Rust regex has no look-around; v1.0.124 broke every Codex user with that. The doc still cites `mcp__(?!...)` style patterns for other agents.
findings.evidence: cm-main src/adapters/codex/index.ts:83-99 (matcher pinned to charset [A-Za-z0-9_|]); git show 675fec69: 'Codex's Rust regex crate does NOT support look-around, so it rejects the matcher at boot ... every Codex user on v1.0.124 is broken'
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 675fec69 2026-05-13 'fix(codex): drop look-around from PreToolUse matcher (closes #547 partial)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'Pin Codex matchers to charset [A-Za-z0-9_|] so is_exact_matcher short-circuits the regex engine'. REGRESSION_RISK: a shared generated matcher with look-around re-breaks #547. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: Codex row = exact names joined by '|'.
findings.fix: Add to PRD §15.2/TECH-SPEC §3.x: the Codex matcher is a '|' list of exact tool names, no regex syntax; add a golden test that the generated Codex hooks.json matcher matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_|]+$/.

findings.claim: ADR-0016 says Codex rewrite is 'supported' with no minimum version. Codex honors PreToolUse allow+updatedInput only from 0.141.0; older builds ignore it. Under 'no fallback chains', the doc must say what happens below that version. Also Codex PostToolUse updatedMCPToolOutput is rejected (fails open), so case C is only `decision:block` + reason, and the doc does not say whether the original output still reaches the model.
findings.evidence: cm-main hooks/core/codex-caps.mjs:25-29 'First Codex release verified to honor PreToolUse allow+updatedInput ... codex-cli 0.141.0' MIN_REWRITE_VERSION=[0,141,0]; codex-rs hooks/src/events/post_tool_use.rs:410-431 test 'unsupported_updated_mcp_tool_output_fails_open' ('PostToolUse hook returned unsupported updatedMCPToolOutput'); post_tool_use.rs:353-369 block -> feedback_messages_for_model
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY ff5b0cff 2026-06-22 'fix(codex): MCP sentinel namespace + PreToolUse rewrites + tool annotations (#844 #845 #846) (#851)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'older builds fail closed (redirect -> deny)' (src/adapters/codex/hooks.ts:16-19). REGRESSION_RISK: dropping the version gate sends rewrites that old Codex ignores, so large output enters the subagent (ADR-0016 MUST). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: fixed minimum version in the adapter row; below it, deny (not a runtime chain).
findings.fix: State the Codex minimum version (>=0.141.0) in the adapter table and ADR-0016; say that older Codex is unsupported (doctor FAIL) rather than a fallback. Add a live check (LV-style) that a Codex PostToolUse block keeps the large output out of the model context.
